full_prompt_en: This square comic illustration looks across a blue river toward a domed civic building beneath an enormous plume of purple smoke. A thin black border encloses the scene. In the foreground, wavy blue water stretches across the lower half, patterned with repeated black curves and a few white highlights. At the left bank, a rounded green tree rises above a small seated figure in a blue jacket, seen from behind and in profile as the figure looks toward the city. A brown boat moves across the river at the right. Beyond the water, a low embankment and rows of small green trees lead to a compact skyline of rectangular buildings and towers. The central building has a blue dome, pale columns, and a broad stepped front. A thick violet smoke column rises immediately behind the dome, bends upward, and expands into a ceiling of tightly coiled cloud shapes that occupies almost the entire upper third. Below this looming mass, the sky glows in flat bands of coral pink, orange, and yellow, interrupted by short dark horizontal cloud strokes. Clean black outlines describe every tree, window, ripple, and curl of smoke. Dense parallel marks provide detail without realistic shading; color remains mostly solid within each shape. The building carries tiny lettering that is too small to read clearly. No natural light source is depicted, but the warm sky silhouettes the skyline and makes the purple cloud feel heavier above the bright river. The image balances a legible urban setting and one overwhelming graphic shape, giving a calm riverside view a comic sense of threat.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形漫画插画越过蓝色河流望向一座圆顶公共建筑，建筑上方盘踞着巨大的紫色烟柱。细黑边框包住场景。前景的波浪状蓝水横跨下半部，由重复黑色曲线和少数白色亮点构成。左岸一棵圆冠绿树高起，其下有一位穿蓝外套的小人物坐着，从背面和侧面望向城市。右侧一艘棕色船行在河上。水的另一边，低矮堤岸和成排小绿树引向由矩形楼房与高塔组成的紧密天际线。中央建筑有蓝色圆顶、浅色柱列和宽阔阶梯式正面。厚重的紫烟从圆顶后方直接升起，弯向上方，扩张为密密盘卷的云顶，几乎占据画面上方三分之一。在这团逼近的烟云下，天空以珊瑚粉、橙与黄的平面色带发亮，间有短促的深色水平云痕。清楚的黑轮廓描出每棵树、每扇窗、水波和烟卷。密集平行线提供细节，却没有写实明暗；各形状内部的颜色基本平涂。建筑上有很小的字，但无法清楚辨读。画中没有明确的自然光源，暖色天空却衬出天际线，使明亮河面上方的紫云更显沉重。画面在易读的城市环境和压倒性的大图形之间取得平衡，让平静河景带上漫画式威胁感。
style_prompt_en: Comic illustration uses crisp black contour lines and repeated short marks to organize complex scenes into clearly bounded areas. Flat, saturated color blocks sit beside one another with little blending: cool blues and greens anchor the lower range, while hot coral, orange, and yellow act against a dominant violet mass. Small rhythmic details accumulate inside simplified forms without losing overall legibility. Scale contrast between compact structures and one sweeping, curling shape creates drama across a shallow picture plane. Even illumination and strong color separation give the result a printed, narrative clarity, with tension carried by composition rather than realistic modeling.
style_prompt_zh: 漫画插画以清脆黑轮廓和重复短线，把复杂场景组织为边界明确的色区。饱和平涂色块相互并置，几乎不晕染：冷蓝与绿色稳住下部，热珊瑚、橙和黄对抗占主导的紫色大形。小型节奏性细节积累在简化形体内部，却不损害整体可读性。紧凑结构与一道横扫、盘卷大形之间的尺度反差，在浅画面中制造戏剧性。均匀照明和强烈的颜色分离带来印刷般的叙事清晰度，紧张感主要由构图而非写实塑造承载。
theme_en: A riverside city under a giant purple smoke cloud at sunset
theme_zh: 日落时巨大紫色烟云笼罩河畔城市
name: Tom Tomorrow
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
